primitive.relation: definitional equality: Extremal D2chr's is_fractional_chromatic G r (unchanged since its authoring 818a76c) is Extremal.foundations.fractional_colouring.is_fractional_chromatic G r: r is the ATTAINED rational minimum of a/b over (a:b)-colourings with a positive denominator (some GTBase b-fold colouring f : G -> {set 'I_a} with 0 < b has r = a/b, and r <= a/b for every such colouring), with no guard on G (the empty graph has value 0). The value is unique; its existence for every finite graph is the LP attainment theorem Atlas.foundations.fractional.frac_chromatic_exists. Distinct and not migrated: X130's existential cross-multiplied bound x130_frac_chi_le, the circular chromatic number is_circular_chromatic, D2chr's colouring-mixing threshold (an infimum without attainment).

attained-fractional-chromatic-number.note: is_fractional_chromatic G r over a rational r: attainment (some (a:b)-colouring with 0 < b and r = a/b) and minimality (r <= a/b for every (a:b)-colouring with 0 < b); D2chr keeps its name as a transparent alias.

upstream_audit.note: The pinned GraphTheory (39 sources) and MathComp have no fractional chromatic number, b-fold or multicolouring notion (in-image search for fractional / b-fold / multicolouring / hadwiger: 0 files). Ownership rule 4: the attained minimum is used by one area (Extremal: the D2chr row and its grounding) and by Atlas foundations; it is placed in an Extremal area foundation next to the circular analogue is_circular_chromatic (Extremal.foundations.circular_colouring, which already imports all_algebra). GTBase has no algebra/rat import, so placing it there would add a mathcomp-algebra dependency to base.
